title: IoTSecFix: A Curated Dataset of Security-Fixing Commits in Open-Source IoT Software
description: Links between vulnerabilities (CVE/GHSA) and fix commits in 14 open-source IoT projects (snapshot 2026-10-25), with CWE, CVSS severity, diff statistics, link provenance and change scope; unvalidated keyword candidates; JSON Schemas; datasheet; collection scripts.
